mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE increase > 0.2 percentage points over 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 11400 and HOUST > 1550 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, strong industrial production (INDPRO > 110) correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 110 during early-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) signals monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing market conditions (HOUST < 1550) indicate faltering consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1550 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 360000) indicates robust consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 360000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS > 136000) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 136000 and UNRATE < 4.5 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
